# Note: S^T S may be ill-conditioned [S1]

The claim states that S^T S may be ill-conditioned. The evidence explicitly states that 'matrix S is not well behaved. It has, in general, a large condition number... making the inversion of (4) an illconditioned problem.' In linear algebra, if a matrix S is ill-conditioned, its normal matrix S^T S is also ill-conditioned (with a squared condition number). Since the evidence confirms S is ill-conditioned, it supports the claim regarding S^T S.
